_about: Week 11 Task Set D - eval cases born from the drill. Case W11-EXCL-001 is the exact request found in the request log (question text copied from the log's question_redacted field; trace id kept for provenance). The siblings W11-EXCL-002..004 cover the same failure on the other items in the same 'What's not covered' list, so the fix cannot pass by special-casing the word 'theft'. W11-CTRL-001 is the over-correction guard: third-party liability IS covered, and a fix that makes the model answer 'No' to everything must fail. Collection eval_acko_bike holds the same 25 chunks as the production collection insurance_documents (verified: identical documents).
